mapper.select: select distinct n.site_code from monitor_notify_log n where n.status = 'pending' and (n.next_retry_at is null or n.next_retry_at <= #{now}) order by n.site_code

select n.id, n.site_code, n.msg_type, n.event_id, n.chat_id, n.content, n.retry_count, e.rule_id, e.status as event_status from monitor_notify_log n left join monitor_event e on e.event_id = n.event_id and e.site_code = n.site_code where n.status = 'pending' and (n.next_retry_at is null or n.next_retry_at <= #{now})
order by coalesce(n.next_retry_at, n.create_time), n.id limit #{limit}
